description.narrative: IN STAGES, THE PROGRAM WOULD FOCUS IN THE STRENGTHENING OF THE COUNTRY'S MUNICIPALITIES ADMINISTRATION WITH SPECIAL EMPHASIS ON THE SURVEYING AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A CADASTRE SYSTEM. TRAINING OF MUNICIPAL STAFF WOULD BE CARRIED OUT IN THIS AREA AND IN PUBLIC FINANCES. WITH THIS EMPHASIS, OVERALL IMPROVEMENTS SHOULD BE ATTAINED IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF REAL ESTATE PROPERTIES, TAXES ON SAID PROPERTIES, TAX COLLECTION AND URBAN PLANNING.
